I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel on Oct 13 at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support. He called it his dealer account and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. A January handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on Jan 5, so it's probably the same account, but that isn't confirmed. I suggested she check with Tobias before the call. I also told her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.

I only used what Pree can see herself: her channels and the public files.
